CompatibilityPolicy: Preserve unrelated mod files. If a different root dxgi.dll exists, copy it byte-for-byte to dxgi.s14rel.chain.dll and install a compatibility DXGI wrapper that forwards exports to the preserved proxy first, falling back to System32 DXGI, then starts SAN14 ModCore. Other shared-file collisions still refuse overwrite.
WindowsDllLoadPreflight: Runs on dxgi compatibility wrapper plus the two relation DLL entry points before any payload write; not executed on Linux builder.
CoveragePolicy: All common CPersonData list/select windows with native tab bars; native Relation pages are skipped.
DXGIProxyCompatibility: Existing foreign/older dxgi.dll is transactionally preserved as dxgi.s14rel.chain.dll and chain-loaded. This avoids the prior same-name install stop, but arbitrary third-party proxies that require the exact filename/path may still be incompatible.
